description:
At DraftKings, AI is becoming an integral part of both our present and future, powering how work gets done today, guiding smarter decisions, and sparking bold ideas. It’s transforming how we enhance customer experiences, streamline operations, and unlock new possibilities. Our teams are energized by innovation and readily embrace emerging technology. We’re not waiting for the future to arrive. We’re shaping it, one bold step at a time. To those who see AI as a driver of progress, come build the future together. 
 
 The Crown Is Yours 
 
 The Crown Is Yours
 As a Data Engineer, you'll build data capabilities that power regulatory reporting, financial operations, and intelligent experiences across our platform. You'll create scalable data infrastructure that transforms complex transactional data into trusted, reporting-ready datasets while contributing to the future of our modern data platform. Working across Engineering, Compliance, Analytics, and business teams, you'll solve technical challenges, improve how data flows across the organization, and build foundations that enable AI-powered experiences and smarter decision-making.
 What you'll do as a Data Engineer
 Build scalable, high-performance data infrastructure that transforms complex transactional and financial data into trusted, reporting-ready datasets supporting regulatory reporting, financial operations, and business insights.
 Develop reliable data solutions that prioritize accuracy, completeness, traceability, and auditability while supporting regulatory compliance and highly governed business processes.
 Leverage AI throughout the software development lifecycle to improve engineering productivity, enhance data quality, and build trusted data products that enable AI-powered applications and natural language access to data.
 Partner with Engineering, Compliance, Analytics, and cross-functional stakeholders to translate business and regulatory requirements into scalable, analytics-ready data models and solutions.
 Design, optimize, and maintain modern data models while following best practices for data quality, governance, observability, and platform reliability.
 Build and optimize cloud-based data pipelines and streaming solutions using technologies such as Snowflake, Databricks, Kafka, or similar distributed data platforms.
 Contribute to engineering best practices for data transformation, streaming, platform performance, and operational excellence while collaborating with and learning from the Data Engineering Team.
 Collaborate in an agile environment to deliver scalable, resilient solutions that evolve alongside business priorities and platform capabilities.
 What you'll bring
 A Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education, training, and professional experience, with at least 2 years of experience designing, building, and maintaining scalable data platforms and distributed data systems.
 Strong proficiency in Python and SQL, with hands-on experience developing real-time or batch data processing solutions.
 Experience building cloud-based data platforms using technologies such as Snowflake, Databricks, Kafka, or similar distributed data processing and streaming technologies.
 Experience working with cloud infrastructure, preferably Amazon Web Services (AWS), along with infrastructure and DevOps tools such as Terraform, PagerDuty, and Datadog.
 Understanding of modern data architecture, including data warehousing, data lakes, ETL frameworks, and scalable data modeling techniques.
 Experience building trusted data solutions that support financial operations, regulatory reporting, auditability, reconciliation, or other highly governed data domains. Experience supporting CFTC-regulated markets or financial services is preferred.
 Hands-on experience using AI-assisted engineering tools such as Claude Code, Codex, or similar technologies to automate workflows, build intelligent agents, and accelerate software development.
 Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment while partnering effectively across technical and business teams.
 
 Join Our Team 
 
 We’re a publicly traded (NASDAQ: DKNG) technology company headquartered in Boston. As a regulated gaming company, you may be required to obtain a gaming license issued by the appropriate state agency as a condition of employment. Don’t worry, we’ll guide you through the process if this is relevant to your role. 
 
The US base salary range for this full-time position is 101,600.00 USD - 127,000.00 USD, plus bonus, equity, and benefits as applicable. Our ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The compensation information displayed on each job posting reflects the range for new hire pay rates for the position across all US locations. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific pay range and how that was determined during the hiring process. It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.
